description:
Read a page of workspace events or events for one resource.

        A call-specific response includes the current ``call_status``.
        Terminal call states are completed, failed, busy, no_answer and canceled.
        This is a snapshot for checking progress. ``call_status`` is null for
        workspace-wide results and for non-call resource filters.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the ``next_cursor`` from the previous page. Omitted: the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

id.description: One resource: ``call:<uuid>``, ``email:<uuid>`` or ``sms:<uuid>``, with the ID from ``place_call``, ``send_email``, ``send_sms`` or their list tools. Omitted: events for the whole workspace.
id.title: Id

kind.description: Only events of this type, such as state_change, agent_turn, user_turn, tool_call or error.
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: Maximum records returned on this page.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: get_events

EventResponse.description: One event on the unified GET /events stream (call, email, or SMS).

call_id.description: The call this event belongs to. Set only when source='call'.
call_id.title: Call Id

email_id.description: The email this event belongs to. Set only when source='email'.
email_id.title: Email Id

kind.description: Event kind within the source (e.g. 'queued', 'delivered', 'bounced'). Vocabulary differs per source.
kind.title: Kind

occurred_at.description: When this event occurred, ISO 8601 timestamp.
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

payload.description: Event-kind-specific detail, as a free-form JSON object.
payload.title: Payload

sms_id.description: The message this event belongs to. Set only when source='sms'.
sms_id.title: Sms Id

source.description: Which channel this event belongs to: 'call', 'email', or 'sms'.
source.title: Source

EventResponse.title: EventResponse

call_status.description: Current status of the call named by the id filter (e.g. id=call:<uuid>). Null for org-wide tails and non-call filters, since there is no single call to report a status for.
call_status.title: Call Status

items.description: Events in this page, oldest first.
items.title: Items

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more results.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

title: Get events
